_why: How many different values answer one spacing question, recorded by npm run lint:token-layer -- --record. A ceiling that only falls: the right number is not 1 (a dense table and a hero are different questions wearing one property), but a question that gains an answer has gained drift somebody has to read.
_remeasured: Third time, 2026-09-04, and the same mistake one level down: it counted a DECLARATION as one answer, so `gap: var(--space-1) var(--space-3)` — a row gap and a column gap, both already on the ladder — was a new answer of its own. Six such pairs on the gap question and four on the surface one, and saying both distances in one declaration is the honest thing to do. A value is split on the spaces outside its brackets now, and the two spellings of a negation (`calc(-1 * X)` and `calc(X * -1)`) fold into one. 16/15/13 → 10/14/8.
